principles: AI is optional; the website must remain fully functional when AI is disabled.
No API keys, tokens, secrets or provider credentials may be stored in browser-accessible configuration.
AI may read normalized canonical evidence and provenance only; it is not a data source.
AI output must distinguish direct evidence from contextual relevance.
Missing values must remain missing and must not be inferred.
Legal relevance does not establish legal applicability to a project.
Listing asking prices must remain distinct from verified developer or research pricing.
AI output cannot mutate canonical or production datasets.
